scope: Warcraft lore through original WoW patch 1.12; later historical sources only within the repository’s pre-Wrath policy, with no later events or retcons.
limitations: Entry-level review, not certification of every sentence.
CMaNGOS is a reconstruction and can contain unused or later rows. Its filename alone does not establish era.
Quest URLs are locators; only the live-check list in the report was independently opened/searched.
Targeted original novel passages were subsequently checked in third-party online reproductions; this does not authenticate every edition or certify every sentence in the codex.
NPC/quest record existence does not verify every spawn, faction classification, or unlock’s complete membership.
